rows.title: SEEC delays approval of Josh Elliott’s public financing grant
rows.standfirst: CT’s State Elections Enforcement Commission found Rep. Elliott slightly shy of the $335,500 needed to qualify for a $3.75 million grant.

rows.title: On taxes, is CT keeping up with its neighbors?
rows.standfirst: CT officials say the state is unaffordable. Some say it’s time to learn from our neighbors and raise taxes on the wealthy.

rows.title: CT to continue working with troubled Waterbury nonprofit — with oversight
rows.standfirst: New Opportunities Inc. will remain a provider of crucial public services in dozens of communities despite a scathing forensic audit.

rows.title: CT lawmakers, advocates push Lamont to release training funds
rows.standfirst: State lawmakers earmarked $30 million to train and employ as many people as possible, but the bulk of those dollars remains unspent.

rows.title: New CT law clarifies property tax payments for solar arrays
rows.standfirst: After several attempts, CT passed a bill last year with a new calculation for levying taxes on large solar arrays. It took effect this month.

rows.title: Citizens’ group seeks to force gubernatorial debate on property tax
rows.standfirst: Municipal leaders hope a fresh look at CT’s enduring property tax problem will push gubernatorial candidates to confront the issue.

rows.title: Bronin, Larson rake in money for primary. Who’s donating to them?
rows.standfirst: Wealthy individual donors and political action committees are shaping the four-way Democratic primary for CT’s 1st Congressional District.

rows.title: Nearly 18,900 CT children have lost SNAP benefits over past year
rows.standfirst: CT’s 15.7% rate of children losing SNAP benefits is worse than the 13% rate reported in a survey of 19 states where data was available.
